findingDetails.title: Implementation summary asserts completion while its body and packet closure state are still scaffolding
findingDetails.evidence: Summary metadata says Completed while the body is literal placeholders, continuity completion_pct is 0, the normative spec is In Progress, all acceptance rows are Unmet and T006-T010 remain unchecked.
findingDetails.recommendation: Keep completion explicitly in progress until evidence is written, then reconcile summary, continuity metadata, spec status, acceptance rows, tasks and report in one closure update.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Cross-read of packet docs and current doctor evidence pointers; no target writes.

adjudication.claim: The packet's implementation summary has a contradictory completed marker despite an empty evidence scaffold and unmet closure criteria.
adjudication.counterevidenceSought: Compared summary frontmatter/continuity metadata with its body, normative spec status, acceptance rows, tasks and goal progress.
adjudication.alternativeExplanation: Completed may be a harmless generated date label. Rejected because the same file says completion_pct 0 and asks for placeholder replacement.
adjudication.downgradeTrigger: Rename it to a non-authoritative creation date and add an explicit in-progress status with no consumer treating it as completion.
